title: Home Mortgage Loans: Escrow Requirement, Waiver Fee and Analysis Settings
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Escrow Requirement, Waiver Fee and Analysis Settings

The escrow account attached to a loan under Home Mortgage Loans holds money for property taxes and insurance. This page records, for every program, when escrow is compulsory, what it costs to waive it where waiving is possible, and the settings used whenever the bank analyses the account.

## Settings explained

- **Escrow compulsory** — either "always", meaning escrow can never be waived in that program, or a loan-to-value percentage: escrow is compulsory when the loan-to-value at origination is above that percentage.
- **Waiver fee** — a one-time charge, stated as a percentage of the loan amount, for waiving escrow where the program permits it. "Not offered" means the program has no waiver.
- **Cushion** — the number of months of escrow disbursements retained as a reserve.
- **Surplus refund threshold** — the dollar surplus, found by an analysis, at or above which that surplus is paid back.
- **Shortage spread** — the number of months across which an escrow shortage is recovered.
- **Analysis interval** — the number of months from one escrow analysis to the next.

| Program | Escrow compulsory | Waiver fee (% of loan amount) | Cushion (months) | Surplus refund threshold (USD) | Shortage spread (months) | Analysis interval (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | always | not offered | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | always | not offered | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | above 80% original LTV | 0.25 | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | above 80% original LTV | 0.25 | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | above 80% original LTV | 0.25 | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | above 80% original LTV | 0.00 | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |

## Questions and answers on these settings

**Can a borrower in the FHA or VA program go without escrow?** No; both programs mark escrow as always compulsory and offer no waiver.

**In the conventional, adjustable-rate and jumbo programs, what loan-to-value keeps escrow compulsory?** Any original loan-to-value above 80 percent; a loan that started at exactly 80 percent is not above the figure.

**Does waiving cost the same everywhere it is allowed?** No. The conventional and adjustable-rate programs charge 0.25 percent of the loan amount, while the jumbo program charges 0.00, so a jumbo waiver carries no fee.

**Hypothetical fee arithmetic.** For an imagined conventional loan of $400000.00 at an original loan-to-value of 75 percent, the waiver fee is 0.25 percent of $400000.00, that is $1000.00. The loan amount and loan-to-value are invented to illustrate the calculation.
